title: Bonds to Increase Safety, Security; Repair, Improve Schools; Increase Accountability
ballot_label: Caption: Bonds to Increase Safety, Security; Repair, Improve Schools; Increase Accountability (Question and summary not retrieved.)
summary: Gladstone School District general obligation bond measure. The district's bond website describes a $55.3 million bond for repairs such as roofs, boilers, fire alarm and life safety systems, and ADA updates, estimated to reduce the existing bond tax rate by $1.45 per $1,000. A July 2026 district article says the district would receive a $10.2 million state matching grant if the measure passes.
yes_means: A yes vote authorizes the Gladstone School District to issue general obligation bonds for school safety, security, repairs and improvements.
no_means: A no vote does not authorize the bonds.
fiscal_impact: District bond site (gladstoneschoolbond.org): $55.3 million; 'estimated to reduce the existing tax rate by $1.45 per $1,000 of assessed value' (current bond levy rate $4.28 to $2.83 per $1,000). District article (July 8, 2026): $10.2 million one-time state matching grant if passed. Official ballot-title estimate not retrieved.
gaps: No YES argument found in T1/T3 sources (pamphlet arguments unreadable; no 2026 press coverage found).
No NO argument found in T1/T3 sources (same searches).
